description:
I’m a Career Counsellor specializing in Engineering Admissions, guiding students across Maharashtra toward the right colleges and branches based on their aptitude, interests, and exam scores. With a strong focus on clarity and practical insights, I help students understand every step of the CAP rounds, cutoff trends, and counselling process — making complex admissions simple and stress-free.

As a YouTuber, I regularly share informative videos about engineering entrance exams, college reviews, branch comparisons, and admission strategies, helping thousands of students make confident choices about their future.

I also collaborate with Aditya (COEP) to deliver authentic and data-driven admission guidance, ensuring students get real insights from top engineering institutions in Maharashtra.
